title: rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner
why_read: A practical, rootless tool for stripping ads and bloatware from Chinese Android phone skins, useful if niche for its target audience.
analysis: This project targets a widely-known annoyance on domestic Chinese Android phones (from brands like Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo) where the OS itself injects ads, hot-search widgets, and marketing push notifications. It works without root access and is reversible, which lowers the risk compared to typical debloating scripts, and it adds an AI-agent-driven one-click mode. It's a solid, real-world utility rather than a research contribution, with interest mostly limited to users and developers of these specific phone ecosystems.
